One place to manage the addresses your app uses.
Demo addresses use example.com. This sample does not send network requests.
No business keys configured. Declare a service in JSON or code first.

Scenario 1 · Switch the whole environment
The Debug demo includes Development, Testing and Production. Choose Testing and save: both order and login move to test addresses.

Scenario 2 · Switch one service
Keep the environment, select the backup address under order and save. Only order changes; login stays the same.

Scenario 3 · Production defaults
Select Production and save to view order.example.com and login.example.com. A fresh Release install starts in Production and bundles only production defaults. Existing saved choices remain in effect after an upgrade.

Changes stay in the draft until saved. Cancel leaves the dashboard unchanged.
